title: Fate's Dawn
next_chapter_hook: "The moment that gaze transcending causality completely locked onto Chen Ji, he heard whispers from ten thousand years ago — that was the first chess piece placed by the ultimate chess player."

text.content: "The fluctuations deep within Xuanwu Sect were like an invisible blade, slicing through the causal order that had existed for tens of thousands of years on the Nine Provinces Continent. Chen Ji stood atop the ruins of Tianqing Sect, the shattered stones beneath his feet still warm from the fierce battle just concluded, yet his divine sense was seized by an unprecedented pressure — as if a pair of eyes was gazing at him from the end of time."

dialogue.content: "It has awakened... faster than you anticipated." Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged from within Chen Ji's mind, carrying a solemnity Chen Ji had never heard before. "That is not the will of any single person, but the 'Eye of Heavenly Dao' that has existed since ten thousand years ago — it treats all prophets as chess pieces, including you."

text.content: "Chen Ji did not respond. His consciousness sank deep into his dantian, where the Tianji Record Fragment that had accompanied him through countless life-and-death moments was vibrating intensely — this was not the agitation of crisis, but a resonance akin to wild joy, as if a wandering child had finally awaited the day of return."

dialogue.content: "Are you trying to say this is the moment you have been waiting for all along?" Chen Ji murmured in his heart, his fingertips unconsciously stroking the golden纹路 on his chest — that was the mark of the Tianji Record's fusion with his soul. For fifteen years, it had never burned so intensely.

"Space suddenly resonated with a presence that transcended sound itself. This was not thunder in the ears, but a tremor directly branded into the depths of his divine soul: 'Chen Ji — Seventeenth Generation Inheritor of the Tianji Record.' That voice carried no emotion, yet it made all the hairs on Chen Ji's body stand on end. 'You have tampered with a chess game that was never meant to be yours.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly raised his head. He saw it — in the direction of Xuanwu Sect, an eye was slowly opening. That pupil had no distinction between sclera and iris, only an abyss woven from endlessly flowing strands of causality, and at the end of that abyss, countless futures he had 'foreseen' were collapsing."

choice.prompt: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao accused Chen Ji of tampering with a chess game that did not belong to him — this was a historic moment. The rules of fate were being rewritten. Facing this existence that transcended Heavenly Dao itself, Chen Ji had to respond."

choices.text: "Stare directly at the Eye of Heavenly Dao and retort coldly"
choices.description: "Question the strong as a weakling: if everything is within your control, is my 'tampering' also part of your chess game?"
choices.visible_cost: "Reveal deep control over the Tianji Record"
choices.visible_reward: "Suppress the Eye of Heavenly Dao and obtain key information"
choices.process_label: 以退为进，试探终极真相

text.content: "Chen Ji faced that gaze transcending causality, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth: 'Since you know I tampered with the chess game, you should also know — pieces turning against the player has always been a player's greatest oversight.'"

choices.text: "Maintain silence and activate the Tianji Record's main body"
choices.description: "Do not engage the Eye of Heavenly Dao in direct confrontation, but sink consciousness into the core of the Tianji Record, waiting for the moment when the main body fully awakens."
choices.visible_reward: "The Tianji Record's main body awakens and becomes true partners with Chen Ji"
choices.process_label: 积蓄力量，等待反击时刻

text.content: "Chen Ji did not speak. His consciousness receded like the tide into the depths of his dantian, touching that constantly trembling fragment. In an instant, a warm force surged from the fragment, intertwining and merging with his divine soul — that was a contract fifteen years in the making finally becoming complete."

"The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light. That radiance was no longer confined to his dantian but broke through his physical form, forming a golden river stretching across ten thousand li between heaven and earth in the world — all woven strands of causality emitted a resonance-like tremor in the same instant."

dialogue.content: "It is complete..." Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled with emergence. "Fifteen years. The inheritor and the Tianji Record have finally become true partners. What Chen Xuan failed to accomplish back then, you have achieved today. At this moment, you are no longer a piece — you are the one who plays the game."

"The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil contracted sharply. Within those abyssal depths woven from strands of causality, fluctuations resembling emotion appeared for the first time — that was surprise, rage, and a kind of offended arrogance. 'You dare...' Its voice carried fluctuations it had never possessed before. 'Touch the origin of the Tianji Record?'"

text.content: "Chen Ji felt an information stream rush into his divine sense — that was the knowledge unsealed when the Tianji Record's main body awakened, regarding the true origin of the Eye of Heavenly Dao: Ten thousand years ago, an existence that had surpassed the Mahayana stage split its own will, one part becoming Heavenly Dao's laws, the other transforming into this 'eye,' attempting to use all beings as chess pieces to eternally control destiny."

dialogue.content: "At this moment, a blurry image flashed before Chen Ji's eyes — that was Chen Nian's face, bound by countless chains in some dark space. Her existence was like a key, interfering with all causal foresight, causing the images Chen Ji saw at this moment to be fragmented and incoherent."

"Niannian..." Chen Ji's heart and mind fluctuated violently. Fifteen years of planning, countless glimpses of the future, all for the sake of finding her. And now, after the Tianji Record fully awakened, he sensed his sister's presence clearly for the first time — she was sealed deep within the Holy Sect, used as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.'"

choice.prompt: "The Tianji Record's main body awakened, Chen Ji obtained crucial truth about the Eye of Heavenly Dao, and simultaneously sensed his sister Chen Nian's precise location. This was a historic moment for breaking shackles, but the Eye of Heavenly Dao was pressing down on him with all its might."

choices.text: "Use the power of the Tianji Record's origin to tear apart the Eye of Heavenly Dao's causal network head-on"
choices.description: "This was madness — using the complete power of the Tianji Record's origin to engage the Eye of Heavenly Dao in a confrontation at the causal level, possibly rewriting the rules of destiny entirely."
choices.visible_reward: "Rewrite the rules of the destiny chess game, shaking the entire cultivation world"
choices.risk_hint: "Too low Heavenly Fate will cause divine soul collapse"
choices.process_label: 以本源对本源，正面决战

text.content: "Chen Ji凝聚 the power of the Tianji Record's origin at his fingertip, golden light forming an invisible sword that stabbed directly toward that abyssal eye. In that instant, above the Nine Provinces Continent, the wind and clouds changed color, countless causal strands shattered and reorganized amid the collision — that was the roar of destiny's rules being rewritten.'"

choices.text: "Retreat and settle for the next best thing: rescue Chen Nian first"
choices.description: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao cannot be fought directly, but Chen Nian's position has been locked. Prioritize rescuing his sister, obtain the power of the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' then do battle with the Eye of Heavenly Dao."
choices.visible_cost: "Give the Eye of Heavenly Dao breathing room"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain Chen Nian, activate the shared fate buff"
choices.risk_hint: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao may strike at Chen Nian first"

text.content: "Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, ignoring the Eye of Heavenly Dao's pressure. His divine sense locked onto that blurry chain deep within the Holy Sect, his form flickering as he was about to tear through the void — 'Want to leave?' The Eye of Heavenly Dao roared in fury, 'What do you take me for?'"

choices.text: "Negotiate with the Eye of Heavenly Dao, trading information for time"
choices.description: "Utilize the information advantage gained after the Tianji Record's completion to engage in a game of strategy with the Eye of Heavenly Dao — perhaps the chess game from ten thousand years ago still holds undiscovered variables."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain crucial intelligence, discover clues to the ultimate chess player"
choices.risk_hint: "May be schemed against by the Eye of Heavenly Dao"

text.content: "Chen Ji abruptly halted, turning to face those abyssal eyes directly: 'You have schemed for ten thousand years, yet do you not wish to know — who is the one who also used you as a chess piece?' The moment these words fell, the Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil contracted violently.'"

"The Eye of Heavenly Dao's causal network suddenly halted. Within those abyssal pupils, countless causal strands raged and churned, as if some long-buried taboo had been touched. After a moment of silence, that voice transcending causality rang out again, but this time carrying a trace of... turmoil it itself had never experienced."

dialogue.content: "What... do you know?" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice cracked for the first time. The chess game from ten thousand years ago, it had never mentioned to anyone — it thought itself the only chess player, yet had no knowledge that in an even more distant past, it itself was merely someone's chess piece."

text.content: "Chen Ji felt the information torrent transmitted by the Tianji Record's main body — that was the final layer of truth Mo Xiansheng unsealed at the crucial moment: the Eye of Heavenly Dao was merely the first chess piece placed by the ultimate chess player. The true chess player had never appeared in any strand of causality, because its existence itself transcended the definition of 'causality.'"

dialogue.content: "This is why the Tianji Record must be complete —" Mo Xiansheng's voice was weary yet relieved. "Because only a complete Tianji Record can glimpse a fraction of that ultimate chess player. Chen Xuan was one step away from touching the truth back then, yet failed at the crucial moment... Today, it is your turn."

choice.prompt: "Fragments of the ultimate truth have already emerged. The Eye of Heavenly Dao is a chess piece being manipulated, while that ultimate chess player hides beyond causality. This is a historic moment — Chen Ji must decide how to utilize this intelligence."

choices.text: "Extend an olive branch to the Eye of Heavenly Dao: cooperate against the true enemy"
choices.description: "Transform the Eye of Heavenly Dao from 'enemy' to 'ally' — after all, it is also a victim of manipulation. Turning enemies into allies is the chess game Chen Ji excels at."
choices.visible_reward: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao temporarily retreats, gaining breathing room"
choices.risk_hint: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao may feign cooperation then turn against him"

text.content: "Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, golden light swirling around him like dragons and serpents dancing: 'You have schemed for ten thousand years, yet did not know you were also a piece — why not let us join hands to overturn this chess game?' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil contracted violently, and that transcendent causal existence fell silent.'"

choices.text: "Seize the moment when the Eye of Heavenly Dao wavers, completely suppress it with the Tianji Record's origin"
choices.description: "The moment an enemy wavers is the best opportunity to attack. Use the complete power of the Tianji Record's origin to temporarily seal the Eye of Heavenly Dao, buying time for the final showdown."
choices.visible_reward: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao temporarily withdraws, a vacuum appears in the destiny chess game"
choices.risk_hint: "May provoke the ultimate chess player to appear ahead of schedule"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not hesitate. He propelled the power of the Tianji Record's origin to its absolute limit, the golden river transforming into countless chains that wound toward those abyssal eyes. The Eye of Heavenly Dao let out a furious roar: 'You dare — !' Yet its causal network was already collapsing, fear appearing in its pupils for the first time.'"

"Just as the golden chains were about to completely bind the Eye of Heavenly Dao, a voice transcending time and space suddenly rang out — that voice existed in no particular direction yet simultaneously existed within all causality. Chen Ji's foresight was completely interrupted at this moment; the last image he saw was a pale hand slowly extending from the void."

dialogue.content: "It has come..." The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice actually carried a trace of... reverence? Those abyssal pupils疯狂转动, breaking free from part of the golden chains' binding. "Ultimate chess player... Ten thousand years, and you finally deign to show yourself?" Its question mixed rage and fear, yet the arrogance of overlooking all beings from above was gone.

text.content: "Chen Ji felt an unprecedented pressure. That was not the pressure from the Eye of Heavenly Dao, but a deeper, older, more transcending sense of existence. The Tianji Record's main body疯狂震颤 within his divine sense, as if warning, yet also... welcoming. Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled with emergence: 'That is the one who laid this chess game ten thousand years ago — the ultimate chess player.'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, withdrawing the Tianji Record's power into his dantian. Golden light gradually收敛, he did not continue attacking the Eye of Heavenly Dao, but stood with hands behind his back, his gaze penetrating the fog of causality to stare directly at that pale hand slowly emerging from the void. 'I have been waiting for you a long time —' his voice was terrifyingly calm, 'the chess player who has schemed for ten thousand years.'"

text.content: "The pale hand stopped mid-air, a voice emerging from that hand, gentle to the point of being almost compassionate, yet causing Chen Ji's divine soul to involuntarily shudder: 'Seventeenth generation inheritor of the Tianji Record... you have exceeded my expectations.' After a pause, that voice continued, 'But do you know — everything you pursue — your sister, your master, the destiny you think you can defeat — from the very beginning, was within my chess game?'"

"The Nine Provinces Continent fell into eerie silence at this moment. The Eye of Heavenly Dao ceased its struggles, the bizarre fluctuations deep within Xuanwu Sect temporarily calmed, and even Chen Nian in the distant Demonic Path Holy Sect seemed to sense something, blurry foresight images flashing before her eyes — that was the back of a young man, standing alone before the source of the entire river of causality.

Chen Ji stood atop the ruins of Tianqing Sect, his garments fluttering violently in the fierce wind. His eyes held calmness, determination, and a trace of... anticipation he himself had not noticed. Fifteen years. From a servant disciple written off as废物 to now one who commanded the complete Tianji Record and dared to face the ultimate chess player — he had walked this path more alone than anyone, yet more thoroughly than anyone."

"Then let me see —" Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, the golden light of the Tianji Record's main body gathering once more, yet no longer in an attacking posture, but rather a golden scroll slowly unfurling. "Whether your chess game of eternal doom has a place for someone named Chen Ji." His voice was not loud, yet it penetrated the fog of causality, echoing through every corner of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.

History froze at this moment. The rules of destiny had been rewritten, a new chess game was about to unfold. And Chen Ji, this former废物 disciple, stood at the center of the chessboard, awaiting the first direct confrontation with the ultimate chess player.
